name: dseny-inspections
description: Prepare scaffold and shed inspection reports from pasted calendar details and inspector observations, preserving original DOCX templates and creating unsent Gmail drafts when available.

interface.shortDescription: Create scaffold and shed reports and Gmail drafts
interface.longDescription: Collect pasted appointment details, attendees and photo-supported inspection findings. Prepare separate scaffold/shed reports, with open items in the email body and No OIs reports as DOCX/PDF attachments. Never sends mail.
defaultPrompt: Prepare my scaffold and shed inspection reports from this calendar entry and my findings.
